scope: Native memory retrieval experiments, not a model of a brain

threads.question: Can associations recover useful memories beyond direct similarity?
threads.candidate: Unit-seed personalized PageRank with dangling-node retention and similarity blending
threads.limit: High graph rank is useful only when the learned graph and seeds reflect the task.

threads.question: Does estimated usefulness improve on structural need alone?
threads.candidate: gain-need: normalized PPR need times a smoothed mean of optional explicit usefulness feedback
threads.limit: Usefulness ratings are a gain proxy, not Bellman improvement or causal utility. Need uses the available finite PPR iterate.

threads.question: When does temporal recurrence help or hurt recall?
threads.candidate: power-law: constant-space n/(1+age/scale)^decay, bounded by x/(1+x); exact ACT-R history sum is an offline reference
metrics: recall@k on evolving and stationary tasks
threads.limit: The runtime proxy ages the aggregate from the last deliberate use. It is not exact ACT-R. Existing STI/MTI/LTI supply a separate multi-exponential comparator.

threads.question: Does explicit competition improve allocation beyond a normalized seed?
threads.candidate: Existing unit seed and caller-selected top-k; stable temperature softmax as an offline reference
threads.limit: Conserved query mass is an engineering invariant, not a conserved biological substance.

threads.question: Can a fading repetition penalty reduce loops without suppressing needed revisits?
threads.candidate: inhibition: baseline score times 1-strength*2^(-age/half-life), blended with baseline
threads.limit: A temporary score bias is not a fairness guarantee. Ordinary similarity and direct ID reads remain available.

threads.question: Can links learn from co-use without old hubs dominating?
threads.candidate: Existing once-per-turn co-use and row normalization; bounded exponential coactivation as an offline alternative
threads.limit: The bounded update is not Oja PCA. The current runtime still adds co-use weights; normalization alone does not remove historical bias.

threads.question: Can agents choose exploration and cue-versus-prior weighting effectively?
threads.candidate: Existing adjustable restart, seed mix and selector mix; temperature sweep offline
threads.limit: No automatic controller or one-to-one mapping to a neurotransmitter is claimed.

threads.question: When does a small nonlinear focus help partial cues, and when does it lock in?
threads.candidate: Small focus boost with explicit reset; a stickiness probe, not a Hopfield model
threads.limit: No attractor feedback is enabled in ordinary retrieval.

threads.question: Would another graph kernel be a better candidate generator?
threads.candidate: Finite Poisson-weighted heat-kernel series against geometric PPR on the same graph; omitted mass is reported
threads.limit: An anatomical connectome is not a semantic memory graph.

threads.question: How do we detect repetition, concentration, scatter and relevant-memory starvation?
threads.candidate: Passive same-pool arm comparison and repeat-within-half-life observation; labelled synthetic failures
threads.limit: These are software diagnostics, not psychiatric diagnoses. Without task labels they do not establish usefulness.

evaluation.design: Same candidate pool and top-k first; independent arms before combinations. Synthetic labels test mechanisms, not general agent task success.
